top_violation_types.title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §747.5107(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was not conducting monthly fire extinguisher inspections.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §747.5107(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguisher has not been serviced.

top_violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §747.209(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not update their liability insurance information by the renewal date.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies lacked information regarding parent rights.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants (26 TAC §747.501(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include infant safe sleep.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Caregivers- Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1303(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the time of the inspection the primary caregiver s First Aid and CPR certification was expired.

top_violation_types.title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The smoke detector was not working and there was not a smoke detector in the front room.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §747.2319(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Bottles were observed not properly labeled with the child's first name and initial of last name.
